title: Add docs/smoke/hello.md with one line
description:
Create the file docs/smoke/hello.md containing exactly this one line:

Nothing else. Do not modify any other file. There are no tests to write for this tick; it exists only to prove a worker in a Cloudflare sandbox can clone, edit, commit and push.
